intro.text: A give-and-take link, close to the way aethers ought to work, through which Midnight Essence draws water from a person. In return that person can control the creature, and with more water can even put their awareness into it.

A give-and-take link through which Midnight Essence draws water from a person in return for control of the creature. The more control, the more water it drains. The link can show as black lines, and a silver knife can cut it.

description.text: What the bond trades is physical matter, usually water, in return for the power to direct the bonded aether.
Among the spores, only midnight spores are known to form it, once they have grown into Midnight Essence.

items.text: Midnight Essence bonds with someone close by who has watered its spores, and it will switch to a person who offers it more water.
Drinking more water and passing more of it to the aether can strengthen the bond.
Someone bonded feels a fierce thirst as water is pulled from their body. The more direct control they take over the creature, the more water it drains.
For some, the bond shows as black lines, and a silver knife can cut through it.
Midnight Essence can also drop a bond by itself in order to join a new host.
